name: dnp3-fieldassist
description: Offline-first PWA for decoding raw DNP3 hex frames during SCADA loop checks.

scripts.copy: shx mkdir -p dist && shx cp index.html offline.html 404.html privacy.html style.css app.js sw-register.js manifest.webmanifest robots.txt sitemap.xml browserconfig.xml humans.txt security.txt dist/ && shx cp -r js icons .well-known dist/
scripts.build: npm run clean && npm run copy && npm run sw
